item.title: US, Nigeria carry out fresh strikes on Islamic State group
item.description: The United States and Nigeria carried out air strikes against Islamic State group targets in northeastern Nigeria on Sunday. The region faces the double threat of attacks from jihadist groups and from criminal gangs that carry out kidnappings, including one that resulted in the abduction of 46 people, most of them children, on Friday.

item.title: How Trump's approach with Iran mirrors similar choices made with North Korea
item.description: Trump shifts from diplomacy to force on Iran's nuclear ambitions, echoing past U.S. dilemmas with North Korea, where similar choices by presidents produced very different outcomes.

item.title: Hezbollah support endures in south Lebanon as ceasefire fails to stop war with Israel
item.description: Despite continuing Israeli attacks and occupation, many people in the south still believe the armed group is the only force capable of defending them.

item.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza have stepped up since halt in bombing in Iran
item.description: At least five Palestinians were killed in Israeli strikes on the Gaza Strip on May 17. Israel has stepped up attacks in Gaza in the weeks since halting its ​joint bombing ‌with the US in Iran. Netanyahu's government says Hamas fighters are tightening their grip on the strip. The devastated Palestinian territory has seen near-daily Israeli fire since the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas went into effect in October.

item.title: U.S. and Israel prepare for potential return to full-scale war with Iran
item.description: Events over the weekend highlight the risk of renewed war, as the United States and Israel signal they would be ready to fight Iran again.
